11:7.text: And He it is Who has created the heavens and the earth in six Days and His Throne was on the water, that He might try you, which of you is the best in deeds. But if you were to say to them: "You shall indeed be raised up after death," those who disbelieve would be sure to say, "This is nothing but obvious magic.

11:8.text: And if We delay the torment for them till a determined term, they are sure to say, "What keeps it back?" Verily, on the day it reaches them, nothing will turn it away from them, and they will be surrounded by
that at which they used to mock!

11:9.text: And if We give man a taste of Mercy from Us, and then withdraw it from him, verily! he is despairing, ungrateful.

11:10.text: But if We let him taste good
has touched him, he is sure to say: "Ills have departed from me." Surely, he is exultant, and boastful

11:11.text: Except those who show patience and do righteous good deeds: those, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward
